name: Norflurazepam
metabolism: The detected in the lab phase I metabolites of norflurazepam were hydroxynorflurazepam and dihydroxynorflurazepam. Norflurazepam is the active metabolite of flurazepam and shows a significantly increased time in the body of 40-250 hours against 2-3 hours for the parent compound.
summary: Norflurazepam (N-desalkylflurazepam) is a long-acting benzodiazepine analogue and an active metabolite of several benzodiazepines. It has also been sold as a designer drug.
